work_identified: Johann Wilhelm Petersen, two-part appendix on Duke Moritz Wilhelm of Saxe-Zeitz's return to Lutheranism (1719): I. Kurtze Erzehlung (narrative of Petersen's conversation with the duke about the Catholic Mass); II. Freude im Himmel (sermon on Luke 15 celebrating the duke's reconversion). Published as a single 123-page bibliographic unit appended to Buder's Merkwürdiges Leben... Moritz Wilhelms. Two distinct occasional pieces unified by subject; catalogued as one work in CERL/VD18. Treated as a single bibliographic work, not a multi-work container.
